Record Class NodeDefinition

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
tech.kayys.wayang.plugin.spi.node.NodeDefinition
Record Components:
type - Unique node-type identifier, e.g. "rag-executor"
label - Human-readable display name
category - Top-level category for UI grouping (e.g. "AI", "Human")
subCategory - Optional sub-category
description - Short description of what the node does
icon - Icon identifier (default "box")
color - Hex color for UI rendering (default "#6B7280")
configSchema - JSON Schema string for the node's configuration
inputSchema - JSON Schema string for the node's input
outputSchema - JSON Schema string for the node's output
defaultConfig - Default configuration values (may be empty)
public record NodeDefinition(String type, String label, String category, String subCategory, String description, String icon, String color, String configSchema, String inputSchema, String outputSchema, Map<String,Object> defaultConfig) extends Record
Immutable definition of a workflow node contributed by a plugin module.

Mirrors the @Node annotation fields but is available programmatically for runtime discovery via NodeProvider.
